title.narrative: UNDP INDEPENDENT EVALUATION OFFICE SDG SYNTHESIS COALITION

description.narrative: UNDP Independent Evaluation Office to fund the Joint Synthesis of Evidence of Achievements toward SDG 16—Peace. The Peace Pillar, which focuses on Peace, Justice, and Strong Institutions, is a critical dimension of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. It emphasizes the fostering of peaceful and inclusive societies, access to justice, and the building of effective, transparent, and accountable institutions. The Peace Pillar addresses foundational aspects of sustainable peace through violence prevention, ending corruption, and ensuring equitable access to justice. Establishing accountable and transparent institutions also contributes to fostering trust, legitimacy, and partnerships, which are essential for peace. Thus, achieving the targets of the Peace Pillar creates a conducive and enabling environment for progress across all SDGs.
